title: Keyboard manager and better RDP interactions

steps: Set a simple letter-to-letter map and a separate Windows-key shortcut; verify both in a local editor.
Compare the old and current RDP clients with KBM local-only, remote-only and off; record which event path forwards remapped input.
In an already-connected old-client session enable local KBM, test, disconnect/reconnect without changing settings, and retest.
Compare restarting the local hook after reconnect with leaving it installed; retain event/lifecycle observations and separate nonforwarding client policy from a regression.
prerequisites: Use controlled local/remote test machines with permission to configure both; record exact RDP client build and Windows-key forwarding setting. Preserve the existing remap configuration.
reproduce.expected_result: Each client/lifecycle case has an explicit local/remote result and forwarding policy. A repeatable reconnect regression becomes a focused subissue; no blanket keyboard-driver requirement or universal repair is inferred.
reproduce.version_requirement: Current PowerToys plus reported0.91.1 only if an isolated historical comparison is needed
